//: The generated corpus is gitignored, so a clean clone — which is what Vercel builds —
has an empty data/ directory and the app correctly reports itself degraded. The build
therefore regenerates it. The seed is deterministic, so the deployed figures are
This instance runs a reduced corpus: 3,000 customers and 12,000 payments (~15MB)
rather than the 14,000 / 110,000 used locally (~142MB). A serverless function cannot
hold the full corpus — it exceeds the memory ceiling and the cold start runs past the
invocation timeout. Every figure on the deployed site is still computed from stored
records at request time; there are simply fewer records behind them.
buildCommand: npm run bootstrap:deploy && npm run build --workspace @reclaim/web
